# Project your 2026 federal estate tax under the permanent $15M exclusion.

> Free calculator for the 2026 OBBBA federal estate, gift, and GST tax exclusion -- $15,000,000 per person, up to $30,000,000 married with portability. Projects taxable estate and the flat 40% federal tax. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
